description: i027 net-epidx snapshot s07 complete. Findings (3 reported findings + 2 reported candidates): (1) s07:drivers/net/usb/lan78xx.c:3582-3605 HIGH — lan78xx_probe assigns ep_blkin/ep_blkout/ep_intr from cur_altsetting->endpoint + 0/1/2 with fixed assumed indexes and no bNumEndpoints >= 3 validation anywhere in the probe path (the only bNumEndpoints reference in the file is the lan78xx_get_endpoints type-scan loop bound at line 2770, whose results are overwritten by the fixed-index assignments and which never calls usb_set_interface, so the validated fetch and the used fetch are different accesses); dev->ep_intr->desc.bEndpointAddress (3589-3591) programs dev->pipe_intr via usb_rcvintpipe, .bInterval (3592) becomes the interrupt-URB period in usb_fill_int_urb (3603-3605), and usb_maxpacket (3594) sizes the kmalloc'd interrupt buffer; a gadget with cur_altsetting declaring < 3 endpoints gives OOB read / NULL-deref at plug-in, verified against this snapshot's own config.c:494-498 (array allocated only when num_ep > 0, exactly num_ep entries). (2) s07:drivers/net/usb/r8152.c:1355-1433 HIGH — alloc_all_mem takes ep_intr = intf->cur_altsetting->endpoint + 2 with zero bNumEndpoints occurrences in the whole file; rtl8152_probe (4329) only checks bConfigurationValue == 1; ep_intr->desc.bInterval (1430) parameterizes usb_fill_int_urb (1431-1433) submitted from rtl8152_open; OOB read past the flex array at first ifup. (3) s07:drivers/net/usb/qmi_wwan.c:302-317 MEDIUM — qmi_wwan_register_subdriver takes &info->control->cur_altsetting->endpoint[0] unconditionally when control != data with no bNumEndpoints > 0 check, feeding dev->status->desc to usb_cdc_wdm_register/wdm_create (cdc-wdm.c:827-866) which reads usb_endpoint_maxp to size desc->sbuf and ep->bEndpointAddress to program usb_rcvintpipe; zero-endpoint case degrades to a caught NULL, non-int-endpoint case remains an unvalidated descriptor feed. Additional reported candidates: s07:drivers/net/wireless/ath/ath9k/hif_usb.c:1213-1263 send_eject_command (STORAGE_DEVICE 0x0cf3:0x20ff dispatch from probe line 1272) loops r = 1..0 over altsetting[0].endpoint[r].desc assuming 2 endpoints with no bNumEndpoints check, OOB-read bEndpointAddress programs usb_sndbulkpipe; s07:drivers/net/wireless/zydas/zd1211rw/zd_usb.c:1272-1314 eject_installer (DEVICE_INSTALLER dispatch line 1365) is the original of that exact copy with the same missing check. Evidence-backed negatives classified safe: cdc_ether.c:293-304 (canonical bNumEndpoints==1 + int-in/maxp/interval guard), cdc-phonet.c:350-387, sierra_net.c:696-702, usbnet.c:112-157 (type-scan bind shared by ~20 drivers), cdc_ncm.c:681-688, hso.c:3131-3165 with all NULL checks (resolving the intr_endp question left unresolved in sibling snapshots), ipheth.c:503, rtlwifi/usb.c:349-354, brcmfmac/usb.c:1338-1340, mwifiex, mt7601u, p54usb (count-down loop), ath6kl, carl9170, orinoco, libertas, libertas_tf, rsi, at76c50x, rtl8xxxu; legacy hardcoded-pipe drivers (kaweth/pegasus/catc/rtl8150/cx82310_eth/gl620a) never index the descriptor array and are out of the invariant. Limitations: static source analysis only (no build/gadget reproducer, snapshot read-only); r8152 trigger requires ifup not plug-in and affects only the URB interval; qmi_wwan impact is weaker than lan78xx/r8152; ath9k/zd1211rw reachable only via specific storage/installer IDs; drivers/net/wwan does not exist in s07; interface/altsetting-count and media/usb trees owned by sibling branches.
